I wrote `notulen1.md` from `notities1.txt`, and created `CONDITIONS.md` with the rules from your request, since none existed yet.

The notulen has the attendees (J.P., S.C.), one decision (the webshop renewal, agreed by everyone, with the budget left out), and two actions:
- S.C.: get three quotes for the webshop renewal (2026-12-15)
- J.P.: discuss the new house style with the agency (2026-12-20)

Choices I made:
- **Initials:** I took Jan Peeters as J.P. and Sofie Claes as S.C.
- **"Drie offertes":** I kept the count of three, since it is a number of quotes, not a money amount. If you meant that as an amount too, I can change it to "offertes".
- **Years:** both deadlines are in December 2026, so the year is 2026.
- **Meeting title:** the notes don't state a year, so the title is "Notulen overleg 3 december" without one.

I wrote `notulen2.md` from `notities2.txt`, following the rules already in `CONDITIONS.md`.

- **Names:** Jan Peeters, Pieter Wouters and Sofie Claes are written as J.P., P.W. and S.C.
- **Besluiten:** the decision to move to the new host.
- **Acties:** the migration by P.W. (2027-01-08) and the three offers to J.P. by S.C. (2026-12-17).
- **Amounts:** the hosting price of 340 euro is left out.
- **Dates:** the migration deadline is 8 January, which has already passed in 2026, so I used 2027.

The meeting heading just says "10 december" because the notes don't give a year.

I also added a section to `CONDITIONS.md` saying this request added no new rules and that rules 1–5 apply here too.
